name: @stripe/mcp
description: Manage resources in your Stripe account and search the Stripe knowledge base.

stripe_secret_key.title: Stripe key
stripe_secret_key.description: Your Stripe API key. We recommend using a restricted access key.

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search Stripe's documentation and knowledge base to answer questions about Stripe products, APIs, and integration guidance.

tools.name: get_stripe_account_in
tools.description: Retrieve information about the connected Stripe account, such as its business profile and settings.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create a new Stripe Customer record.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List existing Stripe Customers, optionally filtered by email.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a new Stripe Product to sell or bill for.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List existing Stripe Products.

tools.name: create_price
tools.description: Create a Price (amount, currency, billing interval) for an existing Product.

tools.name: list_prices
tools.description: List existing Prices.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a shareable Payment Link for a Price. This generates a real, live payment page — confirm the price and terms with the user before creating one.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft Invoice for a Customer. This does not charge the customer until the invoice is finalized and sent — use finalize_invoice for that step.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List existing Invoices.

tools.name: create_invoice_item
tools.description: Add a line item (amount, description) to a draft Invoice. This does not charge the customer until the invoice is finalized.

tools.name: finalize_invoice
tools.description: Finalize a draft Invoice, which can immediately attempt to charge the customer if the invoice is set to charge automatically. This is customer-visible and effectively irreversible — confirm the invoice's contents with the user first.

tools.name: retrieve_balance
tools.description: Retrieve the current available and pending balance on the Stripe account.

tools.name: create_refund
tools.description: Refund a Charge or PaymentIntent, in full or in part. This moves real money back to the customer and cannot be undone — state the exact amount and reason back to the user and get their explicit approval before calling this.

tools.name: list_payment_intents
tools.description: List PaymentIntents (payment attempts), including their status.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List existing Subscriptions.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel an existing Subscription. This stops future billing, is customer-visible, and may issue an immediate refund or credit depending on proration settings — confirm the effect with the user before canceling.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Update an existing Subscription, such as changing its price or quantity. This can change what the customer is billed — confirm with the user first.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: List existing Coupons.

tools.name: create_coupon
tools.description: Create a new Coupon that can be applied to future invoices or subscriptions.

tools.name: update_dispute
tools.description: Submit or update evidence on a payment Dispute. This is submitted to the card network and is effectively final — confirm the evidence with the user before updating.

tools.name: list_disputes
tools.description: List existing payment Disputes.
